## 📚 Documentation Type

- [ ] README.md improvement
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md improvement
- [ ] New tutorial or guide
- [ ] API documentation (for a specific module/agent)
- [ ] Architecture explanation
- [ ] Code comments
- [ ] Other

## 📝 What's Missing or Unclear?

Please provide a clear and concise description of what documentation is needed or could be improved. Which part of the project does this relate to?

## 🎯 Target Audience

- [ ] Beginners new to the project
- [ ] Intermediate developers looking to contribute
- [ ] Advanced contributors working on core agent logic
- [ ] All levels

## 💡 Proposed Content

Please outline what you want to add or change. You can include a rough draft or bullet points.

## 🤝 Can you help write it?

- [ ] Yes, I'll submit a PR with the changes
- [ ] No, I'm just identifying the gap, but I can help review
